description: The lexicographic ordered sum of two well-orders has type equal to the ordinal sum of their types.
signature:
Ordinal.type_sum_lex.{u} {α β : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) (s : β → β → Prop) [IsWellOrder α r] [IsWellOrder β s] :
  Ordinal.type (Sum.Lex r s) = Ordinal.type r + Ordinal.type s
